subject: Property tax: tax tribunal
bill.title: Property tax: tax tribunal; number of days to appeal a claim for poverty exemption; modify. Amends sec. 53c of 1893 PA 206 (MCL 211.53c).

action.description: referred to Committee on Government Operations

posted_text:
🏠 MI SB 0988 — You Have 35 Days to Fight a Poverty Tax Exemption

If the county board of review denies your claim for a poverty tax exemption, you can now appeal directly to the Michigan Tax Tribunal.

The key change?

You have 35 days from the denial date – not 30 – to file your appeal.

The bill clarifies that if you send your appeal by mail, the deadline is extended by the date the postmark is dated.

Oct. 6, 2026: Referred to Committee on Government Operations.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://legislature.mi.gov/Bills/Bill?ObjectName=2026-SB-0988
